code_review.crafter_not_remediated: The catalog test calls build_stores_payload(), which resolves adapters. psycopg is a required dependency in pyproject.toml, and quality gates already ran this test green (603 passed). Mocking resolve_adapter would drop the secret-redaction assertion. The case-arm regex matches the acceptance scenario; widening it is advisory.
code_review.system_designer_deferred: cmd_<store>_* functions are the start pattern Mongo and Postgres already used. Elasticsearch composed the same pattern. The acceptance scan forbids case arms, and that test is green. A generic waiter is deferred to the Redis slice so this slice does not rewrite the Mongo and Postgres start paths.
